description: This source file defines the 'OpenClawChatTransportEvent' enum and the 'OpenClawChatTransport' protocol, along with default error-throwing implementations for its optional methods. It facilitates asynchronous chat transport operations, event streaming, and session management for a messaging system within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Requests chat history for a given session key, returning a payload asynchronously.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with specified parameters, returning a response asynchronously.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts a chat run with a specific session key and run ID.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions with an optional limit.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets the model for a specific session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Sets the thinking level for a session.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status with a specified timeout.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of chat transport events.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the active session key; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a chat session; default implementation throws an error indicating unsupported.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a chat session; default implementation throws an error indicating unsupported.
